es: Combinar la información de un audio y de un texto sobre un mismo tema, atribuir cada dato a su fuente y señalar coincidencias, diferencias y discrepancias.

vocabulary.es: en desacuerdo con, en contradicción con

teaching.en: According to the voicemail, the pool will reopen on Thursday, but the notice on the door gives a different day.
teaching.es: Según el mensaje de voz, la piscina reabrirá el jueves, pero el aviso de la puerta indica otro día.
teaching.explanationEs: According to + fuente atribuye el dato a quien lo dice; no se usa con uno mismo.
segments: According to the voicemail, the pool will reopen on Thursday,
but the notice on the door gives a different day.
teaching.audioText: According to the voicemail, the pool will reopen on Thursday, but the notice on the door gives a different day.

teaching.en: When two sources differ from each other on a key detail such as the opening time, a careful reader reports the discrepancy instead of quietly choosing one version.
teaching.es: Cuando dos fuentes difieren entre sí en un dato clave, como la hora de apertura, un lector cuidadoso señala la discrepancia en lugar de elegir una versión sin decir nada.
teaching.explanationEs: Differ from: las fuentes no coinciden. Discrepancy es el nombre de esa diferencia entre datos que deberían ser iguales.
segments: When two sources differ from each other on a key detail such as the
opening time, a careful reader reports the discrepancy instead of quietly choosing one version.
teaching.audioText: When two sources differ from each other on a key detail such as the opening time, a careful reader reports the discrepancy instead of quietly choosing one version.

teaching.en: A second account can corroborate a figure, so a detail confirmed twice is more trustworthy than one mentioned only once.
teaching.es: Un segundo relato puede corroborar una cifra, así que un dato confirmado dos veces es más fiable que uno mencionado una sola vez.
teaching.explanationEs: Corroborate: confirmar un dato con otra fuente independiente; aumenta su fiabilidad.
segments: A second account can corroborate a figure, so a detail
confirmed twice is more trustworthy than one mentioned only once.
teaching.audioText: A second account can corroborate a figure, so a detail confirmed twice is more trustworthy than one mentioned only once.

teaching.en: Both the voicemail and the notice promise a lifeguard on every shift, but only the notice says that young children must come with an adult.
teaching.es: Tanto el mensaje de voz como el aviso prometen un socorrista en cada turno, pero solo el aviso dice que los niños pequeños deben venir con un adulto.
teaching.explanationEs: Both + plural marca lo que coincide; only the notice señala un detalle que aporta una sola fuente.
segments: Both the voicemail and the notice promise a lifeguard on every shift, but
only the notice says that young children must come with an adult.
teaching.audioText: Both the voicemail and the notice promise a lifeguard on every shift, but only the notice says that young children must come with an adult.

teaching.en: Unlike the voicemail, which sounds apologetic, the notice is brief and formal and gives no reason for the delay.
teaching.es: A diferencia del mensaje de voz, que suena a disculpa, el aviso es breve y formal y no da ninguna razón del retraso.
teaching.explanationEs: Unlike marca un contraste: lo que una fuente hace y la otra no (aquí, el tono y el motivo).
segments: Unlike the voicemail, which sounds apologetic, the notice is brief
and formal and gives no reason for the delay.
teaching.audioText: Unlike the voicemail, which sounds apologetic, the notice is brief and formal and gives no reason for the delay.

teaching.en: A reliable source makes claims that are consistent with other evidence: the notice matches the council's price list, whereas a figure at odds with that list would need checking.
teaching.es: Una fuente fiable hace afirmaciones coherentes con otras pruebas: el aviso coincide con la lista de precios del municipio, mientras que una cifra en contradicción con esa lista habría que comprobarla.
teaching.explanationEs: Consistent with: sin contradicciones con otras fuentes; at odds with es lo contrario.
segments: A reliable source makes claims that are consistent with other evidence: the notice matches the
council's price list, whereas a figure at odds with that list would need checking.
teaching.audioText: A reliable source makes claims that are consistent with other evidence: the notice matches the council's price list, whereas a figure at odds with that list would need checking.

prompt.es: Según el aviso, ¿qué deben hacer los niños menores de diez años?

choices.text: They may enter alone as long as a lifeguard is present.
They must come with an adult and pay a reduced fee.
They must come with an adult during the session.

feedback.es: El aviso dice que los menores de diez años deben venir con un adulto; no entran solos y, al ser menores de doce, no pagan.

hint.es: Busca la frase que contiene «under ten».

origin.text: NOTICE: The pool will reopen on Friday. Adults pay three dollars; children under twelve swim free. A lifeguard will be present at every session, and children under ten must come with an adult. We apologise for the delay.

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje y elige por qué se retrasa la reapertura.

choices.text: Some repairs are taking longer than expected.
Some of the lifeguards are still completing their training.
The council is waiting for next season's budget to be approved.

feedback.es: Dana explica que el retraso se debe a unas reparaciones que llevan más tiempo del previsto; no habla de la formación de los socorristas ni del presupuesto.

hint.es: Atención a la razón que sigue a «because».

origin.audio: Hello, this is Dana from the community pool. I am afraid that the reopening has been put back, because some repairs are taking longer than expected. Instead of Monday, we now expect to welcome swimmers on Thursday. The entry fee stays at three dollars, and there will be a lifeguard at every session. Please note that the morning lane swimming session is cancelled for the time being. Thank you for your patience, and I will call again if anything changes.

prompt.es: Completa: «Esa discrepancia merece señalarse antes de sacar conclusiones.»

feedback.es: Discrepancy es la diferencia entre datos que deberían coincidir; conviene señalarla en lugar de elegir una versión.

hint.es: Es un sustantivo: la diferencia entre dos datos que deberían ser iguales.

origin.text: Two of the sources say that the museum opens at nine. The third says ten. That ___ is worth reporting before you draw any conclusion.

prompt.es: Compara el mensaje y el aviso: ¿en qué dato difieren?

choices.text: They quote different prices for adults.
They give different days for the reopening.
They disagree about whether a lifeguard will be present.

feedback.es: El mensaje dice jueves y el aviso viernes; el precio de los adultos es el mismo y las dos fuentes hablan del socorrista.

prompt.es: Según el mensaje, ¿por qué cambian las fechas del curso?

choices.text: The teacher will not be back from leave before the weekend.
Too few students have signed up for the original dates.
The main hall is being used for another event until Friday.

feedback.es: Marta lo explica al final: la profesora solo vuelve de su baja el fin de semana; no menciona falta de alumnos ni obras en la sala.

origin.audio: Hi, it is Marta from the studio. A quick update about the beginners course: it now starts next Monday instead of this Friday, and it will run for six weeks instead of eight. The price is unchanged at ninety euros, and all equipment is provided, so there is no need to bring your own. I am sorry for the change, but the teacher is only back from leave at the weekend.
origin.text: NOTICE: Beginners yoga course. Starts on Friday and runs for eight weeks. Fee: ninety euros. Bring your own equipment. Classes take place in the main hall. A full refund is available until two days before the first class.

prompt.es: ¿Qué se deduce del mensaje de voz sobre el aviso del curso?

choices.text: That the notice should be ignored, since the studio has replaced it entirely.
That the notice is out of date on several points.
That the notice is wrong about both the fee and the refund terms.

feedback.es: El mensaje corrige el inicio, la duración y el material, pero mantiene el precio y no toca el resto: el aviso está desactualizado en varios puntos, no en todo ni hay que descartarlo.

prompt.es: Compara el anuncio con el cartel: ¿en qué coinciden?

choices.text: Doors open at the same time as they did last year.
The film show still has seats available for booking.
Entry is free and the last visitors go in at ten.

feedback.es: Las dos fuentes dicen entrada gratuita y última entrada a las diez; la hora de apertura y la reserva de la película sí difieren.

origin.audio: Good evening. A reminder that Museum Night takes place this Saturday. Doors open at seven, one hour earlier than last year, and entry is free for everyone, although donations are welcome. Please note that the film show is now fully booked, so we cannot take any more reservations. The last visitors will be admitted at ten.
origin.text: POSTER: MUSEUM NIGHT, Saturday. Doors open at eight. Free entry. Film show: book online. Last entry at ten.

prompt.es: ¿Con qué fin menciona el anuncio la película?

choices.text: To warn listeners that the poster's booking advice is no longer valid.
To announce a film show that is being offered for the first time this year.
To apologise for the opening time that is printed on the poster.

feedback.es: El cartel invita a reservar en línea, pero el anuncio avisa de que ya no quedan plazas: corrige un dato del cartel, no promociona ni se disculpa.
